image_description: An open, bi-fold restaurant menu lying flat on a surface. The left page features two circular images of food dishes (likely salads or appetizers) with accompanying text lists and prices in red ink. The right page contains a dense list of text items with prices, organized in columns, also in red ink. The background is white paper. The text appears to be Chinese characters mixed with numbers.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the text blocks on both pages
artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters, particularly on the right page, exhibit signs of AI-generated text artifacts. Some characters appear malformed, fused, or lack the sharp edges of real printed type. The spacing between characters is irregular, and some glyphs look like 'pseudo-Chinese' rather than legitimate characters.

artifact_observations.location: Food images on the left page
artifact_observations.reasoning: The food images have a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture compared to typical photography. The boundaries of the food within the circular frames are soft, and the details of the ingredients are indistinct, resembling generative blur.

The perspective of the text lines near the central fold is slightly inconsistent. While generally following the curve, some lines appear to warp unnaturally or lose alignment abruptly, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation.
